listing.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe (mk8-recomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Mario Kart 8 Deluxe integration with statically translated CPU modules, native Vulkan and replacement system services. Older suyu AOT/JIT work is historical and retired. The project reports four Mushroom Cup courses, native saving/restart and controls at 59.50–59.96 FPS; a full game and true 125/250 FPS remain unconfirmed. There are no releases, tags or package files. Game-linked binaries may not be distributed; source/tool use still needs provenance review, and local integration generates private modules. Use your own previously extracted inputs matching the current profile. The root guide does not establish current OS/CPU support, game update/region/hashes or key/firmware requirements independently of retired suyu benchmarks. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
